ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two parallel conductors in the figure, the left conductor is labeled +I, and the right conductor is labeled -I. Point P is located between the two conductors, and the figure indicates that the distance from P to the left +I conductor is d, and the distance from P to the right -I conductor is also d. The coordinate directions include a +Y direction label. Reasoning: For a long straight conductor, the magnitude of the magnetic field intensity at a distance r from the conductor is H = I/(2πr). The distance from the left +I conductor to point P is d, so the contribution magnitude is I/(2πd); according to the right-hand rule, P is on the right side of this conductor, and the magnetic field direction is +Y. The distance from the right -I conductor to P is also d, so the contribution magnitude is likewise I/(2πd); because the current direction is opposite, and P is located on the left side of this conductor, according to the right-hand rule its magnetic field direction is also +Y. The two magnetic fields are in the same direction and add, so H = I/(2πd) + I/(2πd) = I/(πd), in the +Y direction. Final answer: H = I/(πd) in the +Y direction.

raw_record.question_text: Two conductors are carrying forward and return currents of \(+I\) and \(-I\) as shown in the figure. What is the magnetic field intensity \(H\) at point \(P\)?

method.method_draft: From the image, note that P lies to the right of the +I conductor and to the left of the -I conductor, with both separations equal to d. Use the right-hand rule around the left +I conductor to find the field at P points in +Y. Use the right-hand rule around the right -I conductor; because the current is opposite, the field at a point on its left side also points in +Y. Each contribution has magnitude I/(2πd), so add them in the same direction: H = I/(2πd) + I/(2πd) = I/(πd) in the +Y direction.

推理：对长直导体，距导体 r 处的磁场强度大小为 H = I/(2πr)。左侧 +I 导体在点 P 处的距离为 d，因此贡献大小为 I/(2πd)；按右手定则，P 在该导体右侧，磁场方向为 +Y。右侧 -I 导体到 P 的距离也为 d，因此贡献大小同样为 I/(2πd)；由于电流方向相反，且 P 位于该导体左侧，按右手定则其磁场方向也为 +Y。两个磁场同向相加，所以 H = I/(2πd) + I/(2πd) = I/(πd)，方向为 +Y。

最终答案：H = I/(πd) in the +Y direction.
